gallery.title: File:太魯閣峽谷與立霧溪之美.jpg
gallery.source: 太魯閣峽谷與立霧溪之美
gallery.description: Taroko National Park, situated in the eastern part of the Taiwan and established on November 28, 1986, covers more than 92,000 hectares in the northern section of the Central Mountain Range. This park features high mountains and sheer gorges. Many of its peaks tower above 3,000m in elevation, with many natural wonders. The spectacular Taroko Gorge and the scenic beauty of Liwu River can be conveniently viewed from the Central Cross-Island Highway. The varied mountain peaks, numerous waterfalls, diverse plant forms and animal life, together with the indigenous Taroko people, create the rich texture of this unique natural ecosystem.

gallery.source: 台灣軍司令畑俊六一行於太魯閣峽前合影
gallery.description: 1936年（昭和11年）9月，照片中從左起數過來第三人為當時的臺灣軍參謀長荻洲立兵，而左胸前佩戴了一枚大勳章者，即為當時的臺灣軍司令的畑俊六中將。他於1936年（昭和11年）至1937年（昭和12年）期間擔任了臺灣軍司令。照片中其餘的人物我們可以經由史籍推斷為當時一同到花蓮進行訪查的長官們，包括：山內高級參謀、松本大佐、鐮田副官、荻洲參謀長等人。
